```{r setup-chunk, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
```

# Load packages

```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(kableExtra)
```

# Load exit data

```{r load-exit-data}
aff_eu <- rio::import("../../03_data_output/affiliate_panel_brexit_eu_sample.dta")
aff_highEU <- rio::import("../../03_data_output/affiliate_panel_brexit_high_income_eu_sample.dta")

# Use only the biennial-compatible sample to avoid mixing annual and biennial intervals
keep_years <- c(2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020)

aff_eu <- aff_eu %>%
  filter(year %in% keep_years)

aff_highEU <- aff_highEU %>%
  filter(year %in% keep_years)
```

# Estimate pooled DiD models for exit

```{r pooled-did-exit}
pooled_exit_high_income_eu <- feols(
  exitit ~ Brexit | year + AffiliateCode,
  data = aff_highEU,
  vcov = ~country
)

pooled_exit_eu <- feols(
  exitit ~ Brexit | year + AffiliateCode,
  data = aff_eu,
  vcov = ~country
)

etable(pooled_exit_high_income_eu, pooled_exit_eu)
```

# Construct country-industry-year exit counts

```{r load-exit-count-data}
exit_count_panel <- rio::import("../../03_data_output/affiliate_panel_brexit_full_sample.dta") %>%
  filter(year %in% keep_years) %>%
  transmute(
    iso = country,
    FASector,
    year,
    exitit,
    highEU = as.integer(highEU),
    EU_all = as.integer(EU_all),
    GBR = as.integer(GBR)
  )

exit_cells <- exit_count_panel %>%
  distinct(iso, FASector, highEU, EU_all, GBR)

exit_count_panel <- tidyr::expand_grid(exit_cells, year = keep_years) %>%
  left_join(
    exit_count_panel %>%
      group_by(iso, FASector, year) %>%
      summarise(N_exit = sum(exitit, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("iso", "FASector", "year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    N_exit = replace_na(N_exit, 0L),
    Brexit = as.integer(GBR == 1 & year >= 2016),
    year_sector = interaction(year, FASector, drop = TRUE),
    sample_HI = highEU == 1,
    sample_EU = EU_all == 1 | GBR == 1
  )
```

# Estimate pooled DiD models for exit counts

```{r pooled-did-exit-count}
pooled_exit_count_high_income_eu <- fepois(
  N_exit ~ GBR + Brexit | year_sector,
  data = exit_count_panel %>% filter(sample_HI),
  vcov = ~iso^FASector
)

pooled_exit_count_eu <- fepois(
  N_exit ~ GBR + Brexit | year_sector,
  data = exit_count_panel %>% filter(sample_EU),
  vcov = ~iso^FASector
)

etable(pooled_exit_count_high_income_eu, pooled_exit_count_eu)
```

# Load entry data

```{r load-entry-data}
entry_panel <- rio::import("../../03_data_output/N_affiliate_entry_country_industry_year.dta") %>%
  filter(
    year %in% keep_years,
    FA_SectorCode2009 != 0,
    iso != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    EU = as.integer(EU),
    GBR = as.integer(iso == "GBR"),
    Brexit = as.integer(iso == "GBR" & year >= 2016),
    year_sector = interaction(year, FA_SectorCode2009, drop = TRUE)
  )

high_income_eu <- c(
  "AUT", "BEL", "DNK", "FIN", "FRA", "DEU",
  "IRL", "ITA", "LUX", "NLD", "SWE", "GBR"
)

entry_panel <- entry_panel %>%
  mutate(
    sample_HI = iso %in% high_income_eu,
    sample_EU = EU == 1 | iso == "GBR"
  )
```

# Estimate pooled DiD models for entry

```{r pooled-did-entry}
pooled_entry_high_income_eu <- fepois(
  N ~ GBR + Brexit | year_sector,
  data = entry_panel %>% filter(sample_HI),
  vcov = ~iso^FA_SectorCode2009
)

pooled_entry_eu <- fepois(
  N ~ GBR + Brexit | year_sector,
  data = entry_panel %>% filter(sample_EU),
  vcov = ~iso^FA_SectorCode2009
)

etable(pooled_entry_high_income_eu, pooled_entry_eu)
```

# Export table

```{r export-table}
fmt_num <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
fmt_se  <- function(x) paste0("(", sprintf("%.3f", x), ")")

extract_coef <- function(model, term = "Brexit") {
  tibble::tibble(
    estimate = unname(coef(model)[term]),
    std_error = unname(sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))[term])
  )
}

coef_exit_high  <- extract_coef(pooled_exit_high_income_eu)
coef_exit_eu    <- extract_coef(pooled_exit_eu)
coef_exit_count_high <- extract_coef(pooled_exit_count_high_income_eu)
coef_exit_count_eu   <- extract_coef(pooled_exit_count_eu)
coef_entry_high <- extract_coef(pooled_entry_high_income_eu)
coef_entry_eu   <- extract_coef(pooled_entry_eu)

tab_body <- tibble::tibble(
  Term = c("Brexit referendum period", ""),
  `(1)` = c(fmt_num(coef_exit_high$estimate), fmt_se(coef_exit_high$std_error)),
  `(2)` = c(fmt_num(coef_exit_eu$estimate), fmt_se(coef_exit_eu$std_error)),
  `(3)` = c(fmt_num(coef_exit_count_high$estimate), fmt_se(coef_exit_count_high$std_error)),
  `(4)` = c(fmt_num(coef_exit_count_eu$estimate), fmt_se(coef_exit_count_eu$std_error)),
  `(5)` = c(fmt_num(coef_entry_high$estimate), fmt_se(coef_entry_high$std_error)),
  `(6)` = c(fmt_num(coef_entry_eu$estimate), fmt_se(coef_entry_eu$std_error))
) %>%
  add_row(
    Term = "Observations",
    `(1)` = as.character(nobs(pooled_exit_high_income_eu)),
    `(2)` = as.character(nobs(pooled_exit_eu)),
    `(3)` = as.character(nobs(pooled_exit_count_high_income_eu)),
    `(4)` = as.character(nobs(pooled_exit_count_eu)),
    `(5)` = as.character(nobs(pooled_entry_high_income_eu)),
    `(6)` = as.character(nobs(pooled_entry_eu))
  ) %>%
  add_row(
    Term = "Affiliate FE",
    `(1)` = "Yes",
    `(2)` = "Yes",
    `(3)` = "",
    `(4)` = "",
    `(5)` = "",
    `(6)` = ""
  ) %>%
  add_row(
    Term = "Year FE",
    `(1)` = "Yes",
    `(2)` = "Yes",
    `(3)` = "",
    `(4)` = "",
    `(5)` = "",
    `(6)` = ""
  ) %>%
  add_row(
    Term = "Year-sector FE",
    `(1)` = "",
    `(2)` = "",
    `(3)` = "Yes",
    `(4)` = "Yes",
    `(5)` = "Yes",
    `(6)` = "Yes"
  ) %>%
  add_row(
    Term = "R-squared / Pseudo R-squared",
    `(1)` = fmt_num(as.numeric(fixest::fitstat(pooled_exit_high_income_eu, "r2"))),
    `(2)` = fmt_num(as.numeric(fixest::fitstat(pooled_exit_eu, "r2"))),
    `(3)` = fmt_num(as.numeric(fixest::fitstat(pooled_exit_count_high_income_eu, "pr2"))),
    `(4)` = fmt_num(as.numeric(fixest::fitstat(pooled_exit_count_eu, "pr2"))),
    `(5)` = fmt_num(as.numeric(fixest::fitstat(pooled_entry_high_income_eu, "pr2"))),
    `(6)` = fmt_num(as.numeric(fixest::fitstat(pooled_entry_eu, "pr2")))
  )

longnote <- paste(
  "Notes: Columns (1) and (2) report pooled difference-in-differences estimates of the effect of the Brexit referendum on affiliate exit probability using affiliate-level panels.",
  "Columns (3) and (4) report pooled Poisson QMLE DiD estimates for country-industry-year exit counts.",
  "Columns (5) and (6) report pooled Poisson QMLE DiD estimates for the count of new Japanese affiliate entries using host-country-industry cells.",
  "In all columns, the pooled post-referendum treatment variable equals one for UK observations in 2016, 2018, and 2020 and zero otherwise.",
  "To avoid mixing biennial and annual observations, the estimation sample is restricted to 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, and 2020.",
  "Columns (1), (3), and (5) use high-income EU countries as the comparison group, while Columns (2), (4), and (6) use all EU countries as the comparison group.",
  "Standard errors are clustered at the country level in the affiliate-level exit columns and at the country-by-industry level in the exit-count and entry-count columns.",
  "In the Poisson columns, observations with only zero outcomes or singleton fixed effects are dropped automatically by the estimator.",
  "* $p<0.05$, ** $p<0.01$, *** $p<0.001$."
)

tab_html <- kbl(
  tab_body,
  format = "html",
  escape = FALSE,
  caption = "Pooled DiD Estimates of the Brexit Referendum on Exit and Entry",
  col.names = c("", "(1)", "(2)", "(3)", "(4)", "(5)", "(6)")
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Exit probability" = 2, "Exit count" = 2, "New affiliate entry count" = 2)) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

tab_html

tab_latex <- kbl(
  tab_body,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  escape = FALSE,
  caption = "Pooled DiD Estimates of the Brexit Referendum on Exit and Entry",
  label = "pooled_exit_entry_did",
  align = "lcccccc",
  linesep = "",
  col.names = c("", "(1)", "(2)", "(3)", "(4)", "(5)", "(6)")
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Exit probability" = 2, "Exit count" = 2, "New affiliate entry count" = 2)) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"))

tab_latex <- as.character(tab_latex)
tab_latex <- gsub("\\\\begin\\{table\\}\\[!h\\]", "\\\\begin{table}[!ht]", tab_latex)
note_latex <- paste0(
  "\\\\end{tabular}\n",
  "\\\\par\n\\\\medskip\n",
  "\\\\parbox{\\\\linewidth}{\\\\footnotesize ",
  longnote,
  "}"
)
tab_latex <- gsub("\\\\end\\{tabular\\}", note_latex, tab_latex)

writeLines(tab_latex, "../../04_tex/main/TabX.tex")
```
